defects: qa/defects/DEF-p3-environment-101.json (hall air: source 'very hot' vs geography.json 'cool dream-air')

fixed.climate: none of its own: an enclosed, windowless dream hall; the air is hot, close and still (source ch002-p09)

dream_design.flora: wrought and carved lily, iris and poppy stems climb between the locked doors and curl over each lintel; the garden through the little door shows living roses, lilies and fountains in full July bloom
dream_design.ornament_cues: each hanging lamp is framed by a gilt halo roundel; the doors carry curving floral panels, so the row of doors reads as a frieze; the glass table is the scene's glass accent, and a mosaic floor of flowing vine bands shows under it (form and material belong to architecture; the golden key, bottle and cake stay 1862 props, WR-009)
dream_design.palette: warm amber lamplight gold over ivory, sage and faded rose surfaces in the dim hall; the garden glimpse is the one cool, bright pastel (rose, cream, pale aqua fountain water)
dream_design.seasonal_guard: carved flora is seasonless; the garden glimpse is July (no tulips, daffodils or blossom)
dream_design.reason: The lamps, doors, glass table and garden glimpse are explicit (ch001-p11..p14). Ornament and palette are designed to WR-010. This replaces the Gothic-Revival reading for the dream hall (DEF-p4-style-001 b = B).

fixed.garden_glimpse: Through the open little door the garden beyond is in full bright summer daylight: flowers and cool fountains. It is the brightest, freshest thing Alice can see, set against the dim, hot hall.
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the sleeping girl's hot afternoon. The hall's closeness is the July heat on the bank. The row of warm lamps is daylight on closed eyelids, dimmed and turned amber. The bright garden through the little door is the sunlit afternoon she cannot get back to. Her tears flooding the floor echo the still backwater beside the bank.

source.quote: as the hall was very hot, she kept fanning herself all the time she went on talking

also_seen.quote: she found herself in a long, low hall, which was lit up by a row of lamps hanging from the roof
How she longed to get out of that dark hall, and wander about among those beds of bright flowers and those cool fountains

fixed.reason: Heat, lamps, the dark hall and the bright garden are all explicit. 'Dark hall' and 'lit by a row of lamps' fit together as a dim, lamp-lit room with no daylight, so this is not a conflict. The link back to the waking afternoon follows ruling 5.2 A. The hot air contradicts geography.json LOC-hall-of-doors ('cool dream-air'). This card follows the source and the clash is filed as DEF-p3-environment-101; geography.json is unchanged.

states.diegetic_daylight: none inside; warm lamp-light only. Bright daylight shows solely through the little door when it is open (ch001-p14).
states.conditions: close, motionless, hot air under a low roof

source.quote: she found herself in a long, low hall, which was lit up by a row of lamps hanging from the roof

states.reason: Lamps and the dark hall are explicit (ch001-p11, ch001-p14). The heat is stated only in ch002-p09, but it is the same hall in unbroken time, so it applies from arrival. The clock is designed by spreading the dream (ev0002-ev0052) evenly over the waking nap, about 6.7 minutes per event.

states.conditions: very hot, stuffy air (Alice fans herself); from ch002-p07 on, a sheet of salt tears about four inches deep spreads half-way down the stone floor and throws lamp reflections

source.quote: as the hall was very hot, she kept fanning herself all the time she went on talking

also_seen.quote: until there was a large pool all round her, about four inches deep and reaching half down the hall

states.reason: Heat and the forming pool are explicit (ch002-p07, ch002-p09). Only the clock is designed. The swim at small scale moves to SCN-pool-of-tears.

states.diegetic_daylight: none inside; warm lamp-light. When the little door is unlocked, the garden light through it is warmer and more golden than in S01, because the sun on the waking bank is now lower (about 23 degrees).
states.conditions: the same hot, still, lamp-lit hall, dry again: no trace of the flood (the dream simply resets it)

source.quote: Once more she found herself in the long hall, and close to the little glass table.

states.reason: The return is explicit (ch007-p105) but says nothing about the air or floor. The dry floor follows the hall having 'vanished completely' after the swim (ch004-p01, SUP-013); it comes back as it first was. The heat is carried from ch002-p09. The late-afternoon phase comes from the proportional clock (ev0032 is the 31st of 51 dream events).
